name: theranos-text-reader

scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name theranos-text-reader --branch main
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.format: ruff format scripts tests && prettier --write "src/**/*.{js,css,html}" "tests/*.cjs" package.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/check.yml
scripts.lint: ruff check scripts tests && ruff format --check scripts tests && prettier --check "src/**/*.{js,css,html}" "tests/*.cjs" package.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/check.yml

description: A source-linked reading archive of Theranos texts and trial emails.
